beats.title: Shivani back home — Om's ordinary place in the household
beats.plot: Shivani has arrived from college. At home she finds Om checking a simple event/household list. Their interaction carries already-known household courtesy: she updates him about college timing; he remembers her society programme responsibilities. Describe Om as an unrelated, older resident accepted within the family's social arrangements, not her actual father-in-law. The source does not say why or how long he has lived there, so do not invent a rescue or biological connection. Their familiar interactions are not coded as permission for romance.

beats.title: Sisters step down — Deepu known to Shivani, stranger to Kavya
beats.plot: Shivani and Kavya come downstairs for the community-event poster/children's programme check. Rohan has returned for the new night placement and stays with Tara; exact prior return timing is not invented as an earlier scene. Deepu is already handling event materials. Shivani greets him naturally by name and remembers that he handled her noticeboard clip and poster task earlier, using only one brief line of background. She introduces her adult sister Kavya for the first time. No awkward new 'Who are you?' between Shivani and Deepu.

beats.title: Kavya × Deepu — first eye-contact spark
beats.plot: Deepu offers Kavya a copy of the programme sheet as a natural courtesy. Their eyes meet longer than required; Kavya smiles and asks his name even though Shivani already addressed him. He speaks more softly with her than with Shivani, and she finds his sincerity attractive. Brief, reversible hand contact happens when both steady the same poster against the evening breeze; neither seizes or prolongs contact. Shivani notices the mutual interest and playfully teases Deepu. Deepu is pleased but not entitled to more.

beats.title: Shivani teases both; morning biology callback with consensual banter
beats.plot: Shivani retorts to Karan and Aman and makes them compete verbally for the introduction. As the author proposed, she can surprise them with two quick, clearly playful cheek kisses, one on each, then step away. The brothers respond with light teasing and, if welcomed on-screen, a short friendly side embrace/waist-level pose to 'get even'; no forced groping, hidden contact or assumption that her kiss authorizes further touch. Kavya witnesses the easy prior familiarity, Deepu reacts with amusement, and both sisters keep their distinct agency. This is a newly proposed escalation, not silently assigned to the already published morning encounter.

beats.title: Kavya introduced — three interested men, one independent choice
beats.plot: Shivani finally introduces her sister Kavya to both brothers, referencing their known neighbour connection with Ankita without converting them into Shivani's family twins. Karan offers to help carry event materials, Aman proposes checking the poster's QR proof with Kavya, and Deepu can help with the very task Kavya first asked about. These are three different invitations, no romantic claim. Kavya speaks for herself and selects whichever practical help she actually wants — the first smile/eye-contact suggests Deepu attracts her most at this point.

beats.title: The new gentle rivalry — exit
beats.plot: After the brief exchange the three young men register overlapping interest in Kavya. Deepu and Kavya share another shy, direct look; Karan jokingly competes for the next society task, Aman offers a quieter alternative. All remain civil; the contrast is curiosity and playful jealousy, not rivalry that produces fighting, humiliation, territorial threats or coercion. Shivani notices the triangle forming and privately laughs, then the sisters leave; no one has secured a date, kiss, exclusivity or relationship. Cut at 19:23, preserving the choice for the next episode.
